title: Epitaph for Alexander and Rhodope
support: A square marble plaque, broken in half vertically, and reconnected.

material._: Fine-grained marble, likely Lunense, Docimian, Pentelic. Digital microscopy: heteroblastic to homeoblastic fabric (identification based on pXRF, digital microscopy)

layout.p: Seven lines of crudely incised Greek letters, filling the face.

handNote.lettering: Very crudely scratched letters, lunate epsilon and sigma, uncial omega

date._: Orsi speculated on an identification with a hypothetical bishop of the early 7th century, but this remains highly speculative.

provenanceFound._: The left fragment (inv.14469) was found in the Catacomb of S.Giovanni in 1895, in the first northern gallery, III corsia est; the right fragment (inv.191) was already in the museum collection before 1888 and recorded so by Orsi in his Taccuini. Now on display, sector F, Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi

museum.name: Museo Archeologico Regionale Paolo Orsi
museum.description: An outstanding collection of archaeological material. The collection ranges from Siracusa and the surrounding territory (Megara Hyblaia, Akrai, Kasmenai etc) to encompass all of eastern Sicily, reaching as far as Gela and Agrigento. The ground floor covers prehistory through to the end of the Classical period. Upstairs includes Hellenistic and Roman Syracuse and a display of material from the catacombs. A gallery displaying material from Hellenistic eastern Sicily is in preparation.
